showroom.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: transparent decorative cutout for desktop automotive service cards and a compact navigation menu.
Primary request: Create a refined photorealistic showroom reception vignette using the reference's glass entrance and reception counter composition.
Input image 1: composition and material reference only. Its dark solid background must not be reproduced.
Subject: a graphite reception counter with a brushed silver worktop and base, one restrained thin red inset detail, and a simple glass entrance wall behind it with one open glass door on the right. Show the reception space, not a whole standalone miniature showroom building. No car needed.
Style: realistic architectural product photography with physically plausible glass, satin metal and clean panel joints, natural proportions. Crisp main shapes that remain readable at 260 pixels wide. Match the reference's realism, not toy-like isometric illustration.
Composition: landscape 3:2 canvas, eye-level slight three-quarter view; complete contained vignette, centered with approximately 10 percent transparent padding on every edge. Compact counter and entrance occupy a similar overall footprint. A small neutral floor base belongs to the vignette, with a soft contact shadow. No surrounding landscape or room background.
Lighting: soft neutral studio lighting with enough edge separation to work on both white and charcoal surfaces.
Palette: graphite, brushed silver, clear glass and one subtle red detail.
Constraints: genuinely transparent alpha background outside the vignette. Keep all object edges inside the canvas. No people, lettering, signs, logos, watermark, dots, floating symbols, colored backdrop, large roof, extra props, or decorative glow.
